notes: This manifest is the canonical list of automated suites for Forseti.
Keep commands local/dev by default; production runs must remain explicitly gated (e.g., ALLOW_PROD_QA=1 where applicable).

suites.label: Jobhunter E2E flow (Playwright)
suites.command: bash -c 'set -e; DRUSH=/var/www/html/forseti/vendor/bin/drush; $DRUSH --uri=http://localhost jhtr:qa-users-ensure --roles=authenticated 2>/dev/null; QA_UID=$($DRUSH --uri=http://localhost user:information qa_tester_authenticated --format=json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(list(d.keys())[0])"); ULI=$($DRUSH --uri=http://localhost user:login --uid=$QA_UID --no-browser 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\n"); cd /home/ubuntu/forseti.life && ULI_URL=$ULI BASE_URL=http://localhost ARTIFACTS_DIR=sessions/qa-forseti/artifacts/jobhunter-e2e-latest node testing/jobhunter-workflow-step1-6-data-engineer.mjs'
run_notes: Requires: Drupal site running at http://localhost, drush jhtr:qa-users-ensure available, Playwright chromium installed.
The command auto-provisions qa_tester_authenticated user, acquires a ULI via drush, then runs the Playwright E2E flow.
Dual-user isolation tests (TC-11/TC-16) are flagged for manual execution or future jhtr:qa-users-ensure multi-user support.
Exit codes: 0=pass, 2=submission.success=false, 3=no matching job found in Philadelphia.

suites.label: Application-submission routes: auth=200, anon=403 (TC-04, TC-05)
run_notes: Coverage driven by qa-permissions.json rules tagged feature_id=forseti-jobhunter-application-submission.
All /jobhunter/application-submission/* and /application-submission/* paths must return anon=deny, authenticated=allow.
Parameterized paths ({job_id}, {step}) tested with fixture job_id; confirm fixture exists before release run.

suites.label: CSRF Fix — static YAML check (all 7 application-submission POST routes have _csrf_token: TRUE) + role-url-audit GET regression (no CSRF regression on GET routes)
suites.command: bash -c 'set -e; echo "=== TC-01: Static CSRF check ==="; ROUTING=/home/ubuntu/forseti.life/sites/forseti/web/modules/custom/job_hunter/job_hunter.routing.yml; for route in step3_post step3_short_post step4_post step4_short_post step5_post step5_short_post step_stub_short_post; do if grep -A10 "application_submission_${route}:" "$ROUTING" | grep -q "_csrf_token.*TRUE"; then echo "PASS: $route has _csrf_token: TRUE"; else echo "FAIL: $route MISSING _csrf_token" && exit 1; fi; done; echo "=== TC-01: All 7 routes PASS ==="; echo "=== TC-05: GET route audit ==="; ALLOW_PROD_QA=1 bash scripts/site-audit-run.sh'
run_notes: TC-01: Static grep confirms _csrf_token: TRUE on all 7 POST routes in job_hunter.routing.yml.
TC-05: role-url-audit covers GET routes — confirms no CSRF regression on GET paths.

STAGE 0 PENDING: Dev must create CsrfApplicationSubmissionTest.php (PHPUnit Functional) for authenticated-POST-with-token=200, authenticated-POST-without-token=403, anon-POST=403, AJAX-flow=200. See features/forseti-csrf-fix/03-test-plan.md TC-02/TC-03/TC-04/TC-06.
KB: knowledgebase/lessons/20260301-jobhunter-routing-csrf-token-blocks-qa-probe.md — QA POST probes must include valid Drupal session token.
